attributes.action: HRT is personalised to you only
attributes.additional_details: HRT from the NHS is one size fits all, it’s need to be personalised to you only. Also especially when going through the peri menopause, whatever stage your at you probably may need testosterone too but the standard HRT does cover this also and its all synthetic .There our companies out there to use but that’s only if you can afford there Treatment this shouldn’t be the case , you just won’t to be yourself again, doctors say bloods are fine but you no somethings not right (anxiety)(hair loss) etc
attributes.background: At the moment one size fits all approach is what the nhs only do when it come to HRT it’s has Neva change nor do they include testosterone, you may be undiagnosed at minute but my crazy symptoms started after birth of daughter at 37 Hair loss, anxiety, dry eyes, stiff bones, claustrophobia
